scenario: Pluriactividad mid-year: G11's salary of 40,000 (employee SS 2,600) plus an established activity registered in March 2020, whose 2024 net was 30,000, so no minoración. Q1 and Q2 are closed: 15,000 invoiced and 3,155.10 spent to June, the 2,555.10 of six General 7 cuotas of 425.85 that TGSS charged included. The taxpayer keeps that base, General 7's base mínima of 1,356.21, for the rest of the year (#55). The year settles on General 6, whose bases run from 1,274.51 to 2,330.00, so TGSS keeps the 425.85 a month and neither tops it up nor refunds it (#52, #55). The projection for July to December is 16,000 of invoices and 600 of expenses besides the cuota. Stacked on the salary the activity is taxed well above the 20 % Modelo 130 rate, so the annual return will want more, payable by 30 June 2026.

setAside.oracleRef: Arithmetic under the set-aside composition rules of #10 and #15, computed by an independent Decimal script written from those rules and the sources below, not by running the engine. Re-derived for #39 on 2026-09-27 by a new independent Decimal script, written without reading the engine, which first reproduced every earlier expected value of this golden under the earlier TGSS rule and then changed only that rule. #39 restated the actuals to a taxpayer who paid General 6 (1,500.60 to March, 3,001.20 to June), because the estimate then added back cuotas priced at the tramo it chose. #52 adds back the cuotas actually paid, stated with the actuals (cuotasSsYtd), and restores the original shape: six General 7 cuotas of 425.85 in the gastos, 1,577.55 to March with 1,277.55 of cuotas and 3,155.10 to June with 2,555.10. Re-derived for #52 on 2026-09-27 by the #48 script, which first reproduced every expected value of the 2025 goldens on main (153 values) and then took that one rule. The #52 implementer added the rule, so this re-derivation is independent of the engine's code but not of its author; the script shares no code with the engine and finds the tramo by trying each one from the top, not by the engine's iteration. Re-derived for #55 on 2026-09-27 by the same script, which first reproduced every expected value of the 2025 set-aside goldens on main under the #52 rule (154 values) and then took the #55 rule, written by the #55 owner from LGSS art. 308.1 before reading the engine change; the tipo is taken from the Orden, not from the config under test. The #55 owner also wrote the design the engine implements, so the script is independent of the engine's code but not of its designer. A first version clamped the closed months together and each projected month on its own; review found that RGC art. 46.2 regularises one average of the whole year, and the pooled rule was written into the script from the regla text before the engine was changed. It left every value but G20's unchanged, and the reviewer's separate script agrees on G15 and G20. Actuals are the cumulative closed quarters; the projection is spread evenly over the months after the last of them. TGSS (#39, #52, #55): LGSS art. 308.1 (boe.es consolidated RDL 8/2015, block a308, read 2026-09-27). The taxpayer chooses a monthly base (a) 1.ª and 3.ª) and TGSS debits it times the tipos (b)): 31.40 % in 2025, 28.30 contingencias comunes + 1.30 profesionales + 0.80 MEI (Orden PJC/178/2025 art. 18.2, BOE-A-2025-3780) + 0.90 cese de actividad + 0.10 formación profesional (art. 37.5–37.6), rounded half up to the cent: 1,356.21 × 0.314 = 425.84994 → 425.85. Those debits are the cuotas the year's return deducts, so casilla 0186 is 2,555.10 paid to June plus 6 × 425.85 = 2,555.10 debited after it, and the projected gastos carry the same 2,555.10. The rendimiento computable is the IRPF rendimiento neto plus the titular's own cuotas (c) 1.ª), less 7 % gastos genéricos (2.ª, config seguridadSocial.gastosGenericos), spread over the months of alta (3.ª). The net is Modelo 100 casilla 0224 and the cuotas casilla 0186 (AEAT, Información para determinar el rendimiento neto, sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es, page updated 18 Sep 2026, read 2026-09-27); casilla 0224 is after difícil justificación (RD 439/2007 art. 30.2ª: 5 %, at most 2,000) and before every LIRPF art. 32 reduction and the other reductions Modelo 100 2025 takes after it, in casillas 0225, 0232–0234 and 0236–0237 (Anexo I, página 9), so the art. 32.3 reduction does not lower it. The debits do not depend on the tramo, so one computable follows and one tramo contains it. TGSS then regularises the year as a whole (c) 3.ª–4.ª and RD 2064/1995 art. 46.2, boe.es BOE-A-1996-1579 block a46, version in force from 2024-08-01, read 2026-09-27): regla 3.ª sums the provisional bases of the year's months less the tarifa plana days (1.ª), divides by those days and multiplies by 30; regla 5.ª compares that one average base with the tramo's base mínima and base máxima. Between them nothing moves (5.ª a); below or above, TGSS reclaims or refunds the total of the differences between each month's base and the base mínima or máxima (5.ª b and c), at the period's tipo (7.ª). A whole month counts 30 days, as RGC art. 45.1 prorates the cuota, so the average lies below the base mínima exactly when the year's debits total less than the cuotas at it, and TGSS keeps the year's debits, closed and projected months pooled, clamped between the cuotas at the tramo's base mínima and base máxima summed over those months; tarifa plana months are not regularised (Ley 20/2007 art. 38 ter.6) and stay as debited. Modelo 130: AEAT instrucciones del modelo 130 (sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es, page updated 11 Sep 2026, read 2026-09-26), casillas 01–19, and RD 439/2007 art. 30.2ª and 110 (difícil justificación in casilla 02; casilla 12 floors 07 at zero; casilla 14 = 12 − 13 may be negative; casilla 15 deducts earlier negative casilla 19 results, at most a positive casilla 14). Annual: SPEC-002 steps 1, 2, 4 and 6, LIRPF art. 19, 20, 30.2.4ª, 32.3, 56, 63 and 74, VC mínimo 6,105 (Ley 13/1997 art. 2 bis). Hold-back share (Σ 130 + gap + the year's cuotas SS that TGSS keeps) / annual ingresos, rounded up to 0.0001. No AEAT simulator, published example or gestor covers a set-aside estimate; this is the weakest gate. Q1 and Q2 as stated pay 1,030.27 and 1,220.26. Q3 to date: 15,000 + 16,000 × 3 / 6 = 23,000; 3,155.10 + 300 + 3 × 425.85 = 4,732.65; casilla 02 4,732.65 + 913.3675 of difícil justificación = 5,646.02, casilla 03 17,353.98; 20 % 3,470.80 − 2,250.53 = 1,220.27, no minoración, due 1–20 October. Q4 1,220.26. Σ 130 4,691.06. TGSS: annual gastos 3,155.10 + 600 + 2,555.10 = 6,310.20, previo 24,689.80, difícil justificación 1,234.49, casilla 0224 23,455.31, plus 2,555.10 paid and 2,555.10 debited after June = 28,565.51, × 0.93 / 12 = 2,213.827025 a month, General 6 (2,030 to 2,330). General 6's cuotas are 400.20 at its base mínima of 1,274.51 and 2,330.00 × 0.314 = 731.62 at its base máxima (config seguridadSocial.tramos). No month is under tarifa plana. The year debits 2,555.10 paid to June + 2,555.10 after it = 5,110.20, an average base of 1,356.21, between 12 × 400.20 = 4,802.40 and 12 × 731.62 = 8,779.44, so nothing is regularised (RGC art. 46.2 5.ª a). The year's cuotas SS are 5,110.20, and TGSS debits 425.85 a month. Under #52 the six months after June were priced at General 6's 400.20, 153.90 less than the account will lose, and the share was 0.4534. Annual: 31,000 − 6,310.20 = 24,689.80, difícil justificación 1,234.49, net 23,455.31, above the 6,500 other-income cap. Salary alone 35,400, cuota 3,872.50 estatal + 3,825.55 VC = 7,698.05; stacked base 58,855.31, cuota 8,211.73235 estatal + 8,522.99475 VC = 16,734.7271; the activity adds 9,036.6771, the advances cover 4,691.06, gap 4,345.62 payable by 2026-06-30 (config calendar.renta). Share (4,691.06 + 4,345.62 + 5,110.20) / 31,000 = 0.45635…, rounded up 0.4564. Due window (#40): RD 439/2007 art. 111.1 and Orden EHA/672/2007 art. 7 give 1–20 of the month, and a last day that is a Saturday, Sunday or holiday of the taxpayer's region moves to the next working day (Orden EHA/672/2007 art. 7; Ley 39/2015 art. 30.5–30.6; boe.es, read 2026-09-27); 20 October 2025 is a Monday and no holiday in the Comunitat Valenciana (BOE-A-2024-26935), so it stands. VC scale (#48): Ley 13/1997 (CV) art. 2.1 as worded by Ley 9/2022, disp. final 1.1, for periods ending from 1 January 2023 (boe.es consolidated BOE-A-1998-8202, version in force from 2023-01-01, read 2026-09-27), and the same table in the AEAT Manual práctico Renta 2025, cap. 15, Comunitat Valenciana (page updated 17 Mar 2026, read 2026-09-27): 5,530 on the first 42,000, 20 % to 52,000, 22.5 % to 62,000. Theory §4.2 has 19.9 % and 22.4 % there, rates no version of the law has.
